title: Pip the Mouse Who Kept His Word: A Promise is Golden!

lines.text: Pip the tiny brown mouse made a solemn promise to his best friend Barney Bear!
lines.caps: Pip the tiny *MOUSE | made a solemn *PROMISE | to his best friend *BARNEY!

lines.text: I will bring you the magical blue seed before the forest sun sets!
lines.caps: I will bring you the *MAGICAL | blue seed before the forest *SUN | *SETS!

lines.text: On his way back, Pip stumbled upon a sparkling river of sweet strawberries!
lines.caps: On his way back, Pip *STUMBLED | upon a sparkling river of *SWEET | *STRAWBERRIES!

lines.text: All the squirrels cheered, Stay and feast with us, Pip! Sunset is far away!
lines.caps: All the squirrels *CHEERED, | Stay and feast with us, *PIP! | Sunset is far *AWAY!

lines.text: Pip's tummy rumbled, but he remembered Barney waiting patiently by the mossy rock!
lines.caps: Pip's tummy *RUMBLED, | but he remembered Barney *WAITING | patiently by the *ROCK!

lines.text: Pip said, Sweet berries are delicious, but my word is like solid gold!
lines.caps: Pip said, Sweet berries are *DELICIOUS, | but my word is like *SOLID | *GOLD!

lines.text: He scurried across the bridge and arrived just as the first evening star twinkled!
lines.caps: He scurried across the *BRIDGE | and arrived just as the *FIRST | evening star *TWINKLED!

lines.text: Barney gave Pip a giant bear hug—trust is the greatest treasure in the world!
lines.caps: Barney gave Pip a giant *BEAR HUG— | trust is the greatest *TREASURE | in the *WORLD!

lines.text: Be a friend who keeps their word—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
lines.caps: Be a friend who *KEEPS | their word—*SUBSCRIBE | to *BABYBEATS Rhymo!
